messages:
harry: Quick sync 1 - Vendor: PulseGrid (HW + SI). They want a private offer on marketplace bundling Dedicated credits + appliance rebate. Also want a short public mention during their channel partner day. Need pricing bands, SKUs, renewal incentives, and an announceable blurb. Who can own?
meera: I can draft pricing. prefer 12-mo commit with quarterly true-ups. propose optional 24-mo lock for extra discount.
ollie: Sales asks for a 90-day enrollment credit to speed closes (applies months 1-3). also want a renewal accelerator for customers that renew early.
tanya: Ops: marketplace copy must say "partner-managed rebate" and link to private-offer redemption URL. pass-through requires partner PO + SOW. need sku names and billing cadence.
legal-bot: Note: do not promise HW rebate in public copy. include auto-renew opt-out, export controls, and explicit data-processing references for on-prem. i'll draft clause snippets.
meera: Draft tiers (USD, 12-mo):
- Lite: $8k/mo -> 7% discount, no HW rebate
- Pro: $55k/mo -> 16% discount + $18k HW rebate pass-through + 90-day enrollment credit (months 1-3)
- Enterprise: $210k/mo -> 25% discount + $80k HW rebate pass-through + 2-week fast-start credit
Optional 24-mo lock -> +3% additional discount. quarterly true-up. enrollment credit applied as invoice credit.
ollie: Sales prefers fast-start as add-on for Pro, included for Enterprise. renewal accelerator: 5% one-time credit if renew within final 90 days.
partner-ops: Suggested SKUs: rwd-pulse-lite-v1, rwd-pulse-pro-v1, rwd-pulse-enterprise-v1, rwd-pulse-faststart-2w. Marketplace guidance: neutral blurb, link to private-offer, partner logo tile, FAQ entry pointing to MSA & SOW contact.
harry: Assignments: Meera -> finalize pricing + private-offer JSON; Ollie -> field one-pager + enrollment calc; Tanya -> SKU registration + marketplace draft; Legal -> redlines. Target publish date: 2026-11-03 (partner day) -> need final materials by 2026-10-20.
meera: I'll post final spreadsheet and private-offer export by EOD tomorrow.
ollie: I'll prep the field playbook and demo checklist.
legal-bot: I'll post redlines and a short clause packet by EOD.
harry: Great. If PulseGrid PM escalates ping me @harry. Thanks all. :rocket:
